comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus ballast two oppositely oriented portable goals against forward tipping.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine keyed adjustment and dynamic testing versus orientation reasoning and sandbag placement on load-bearing rear bars.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeatable non-bottoming stops with stable setting versus one bag on each rear bar, scored 0.5 per goal. No load or stability threshold is given.
comparison.reason: Static ballast placement and dynamic shock-absorber commissioning test different physical abilities.
